ranked.headline: Biological priors built into single-cell inference models for dynamics and perturbations
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and journal articles encode causal, network, and dynamical priors directly into single-cell models rather than imposing structure afterward.

ranked.headline: Benchmarked computational methods resolve genomic variation, repeats, and haplotypes
ranked.summary: Explicit ground-truth and benchmark evaluation now distinguishes method performance across noncoding, repeat, haplotype, and structural variant tasks.

ranked.headline: Computational tools expose technical bias and annotation errors in RNA-seq data
ranked.summary: Single-cell and bulk workflows increasingly need diagnostics for coverage bias, annotation validity, and cell calling before downstream interpretation.

ranked.headline: Computational frameworks integrate omics layers and detect spatial and pathway patterns
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and publications introduce scalable spatial, multi-omics, and pathway-scoring methods that encode biological structure explicitly.

ranked.headline: Generative models sample protein dynamics, RNA ensembles, and ligand dissociation paths
ranked.summary: Early 2026 preprints extend diffusion and latent generative models to microsecond trajectories, cryo-EM density, and RNA ensembles.

ranked.headline: Sequence and ML models are tested for variant effect and genetic association inference
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and publications benchmark deep learning and fine-mapping methods against established baselines across variant, locus, and interaction tasks.

ranked.headline: Graph and language models add interpretable drug-disease and drug-drug inference
ranked.summary: Early-2026 preprints and publications pair knowledge graphs and pretrained encoders with explanation layers for drug and gene prediction.

ranked.headline: Web platforms couple GWAS summary statistics to colocalization and network-level analysis
ranked.summary: Harmonized hg38 summary statistics and pipelines now let GWAS results be interrogated interactively, from colocalization to drug repurposing.

ranked.headline: Stochastic models infer selection and mutation from somatic and single-cell data
ranked.summary: Cross-sectional single-cell and somatic sequencing data are being analyzed with stochastic models to infer selection and accumulation parameters.

ranked.headline: Pretrained encoders and structural priors combined for molecular and protein learning
ranked.summary: Explicit contrastive alignment across heterogeneous modalities is comparatively new, exemplified by FLARE's spectra-molecule peak-node alignment.

ranked.headline: LLM agents tackle molecular optimisation, mutation prediction and bioinformatics tasks
ranked.summary: Recent preprints benchmark and build LLM and multi-agent systems for drug-discovery and biomedical ML tasks, with evaluation now a central focus.

ranked.headline: Scalable open-source tools for metagenomic, phylogenomic and proteomic data analysis
ranked.summary: Recent tools target memory and runtime bottlenecks in large metagenomic, phylogenomic and compositional omics analyses.

ranked.headline: Single-cell multi-omics links disease and aging cell states to regulatory programs
ranked.summary: Multimodal single-cell atlases pair transcriptomic states with methylation and chromatin readouts across aging, diabetes and neurodegeneration.

ranked.headline: Quantitative RNA sequencing methods resolve turnover, editing, and polyadenylation
ranked.summary: Recent studies add kinetic, editing, splicing, and 3' end resolution to transcriptomic measurements, moving beyond flat count matrices.

ranked.headline: Deep learning models segment tissues and cells in histology and spatial omics images
ranked.summary: Foundation-model and self-supervised approaches now handle gigapixel whole-slide and spatial omics images at scale.

ranked.headline: Validation design and data splitting determine trust in biomedical predictive models
ranked.summary: Recent QSAR, neuroimaging, and toxicology studies emphasize rigorous data splitting, nested validation, and cross-species concordance in predictive modeling.

ranked.headline: Younger transposable elements drive stronger, tissue-specific promoter activity in humans
ranked.summary: A 26,056-element TSS atlas from 115 human RAMPAGE samples links transposon age to promoter strength and tissue specificity.

ranked.headline: Trajectory-based tools resolve dynamic interfaces and membrane contact at residue level
ranked.summary: Per-residue methods now draw on molecular dynamics trajectories and membrane-specific training to quantify time-resolved interface behavior.

ranked.headline: Multimodal chromatin and expression data are used to model gene regulatory logic
ranked.summary: Cross-species single-nucleus and chromatin profiling now resolves regulatory logic beyond single-modality expression data.

ranked.headline: Biologically grounded mechanisms are used to build or audit machine learning models
ranked.summary: Recent preprints from January 2026 couple biophysical neuron simulation, learning rules, and plausibility auditing within machine learning frameworks.

ranked.headline: Epistatic mutation coupling as image input classifies SARS-CoV-2 variants
ranked.summary: Recent preprints apply learned models to SARS-CoV-2 variant classification, influenza antigenic prediction, and multi-country COVID-19 forecasting.

ranked.headline: Alignment, pangenome, and reproducibility tools for microbial sequence analysis
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and publications report scalable, bit-reproducible, and bias-aware tools for pangenome, alignment, and viral sequence workflows.

ranked.headline: Haplotype-resolved assemblies underpin haplotype-aware variant and trait analysis
ranked.summary: Haplotype-resolved autotetraploid potato assembly and phased apple genomes show haplotype-aware analysis extending to polyploid and cultivar genomes.

ranked.headline: Restrained and coarse-grained simulations resolve disordered protein ensembles
ranked.summary: Temperature-dependent potentials and experimentally restrained simulations now quantify disordered-protein ensembles and phase behavior.

ranked.headline: Graph and geometry-aware models for antibody and cyclic peptide design
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and one published study pair learned structural representations with domain topology, conformational geometry, or optimization constraints.

ranked.headline: Morphology-aware graph learning links histology to spatial transcriptomic domains
ranked.summary: Recent work integrates histology, coordinates, and expression to improve spatial domain identification across Xenium and multi-slice datasets.

ranked.headline: Software tools link transcriptomic data to metabolic and cell-communication models
ranked.summary: New bioinformatics tools couple transcriptomic inputs to metabolic modeling, cell-cell communication, and multi-omics module analysis.

ranked.headline: Deep networks infer gene regulation from single-cell data and cis-regulatory sequence
ranked.summary: Regulatory-structure-aware models now encode gene modules, microRNA layers, and candidate cis-elements to predict expression and regulators.

ranked.headline: Sparse, mixed-source aDNA sampling limits kinship and selection inference
ranked.summary: Simulation and benchmark studies now test whether sparse, multi-source aDNA designs preserve kinship and selection inference validity.

ranked.headline: Structured heterogeneity sets outcomes in epidemic and microbial community models
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and a published model encode behavioral, host, interaction, and dispersal structure into analytic criteria that predict outcomes.

ranked.headline: Alignment-free and ML tools resolve repeats, piRNAs, loops and ghost introgression
ranked.summary: Four recent tools apply alignment-free, machine learning and ping-pong-based methods to repeat, small RNA and genome-structure annotation.

ranked.headline: Simulations tie hydration networks to proton transport in respiratory complex I
ranked.summary: Recent atomistic and multiscale MD studies quantify how hydration connectivity governs proton and ion transport in respiratory enzymes.

ranked.headline: De novo assemblies expose young neo-Y degeneration and stable gar genome structure
ranked.summary: Non-model genome assemblies now resolve sex chromosome turnover and genome stasis at chromosome level across beetles and fishes.

ranked.headline: Structural and alignment methods reveal relationships beyond sequence similarity
ranked.summary: Structure-level comparison now reaches allergen epitopes, binding sites, and recurrent substitutions beyond what sequence alignment captures.

ranked.headline: Learned rewards and language-model priors steer peptide and protein sequence generation
ranked.summary: Protein language models and peptide generators are now coupled to activity, toxicity, and PAM-specificity predictors as explicit generation objectives.

ranked.headline: Stochastic and dynamical models of cell-state transitions and population behavior
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and a dynamic model apply stochastic and early-warning frameworks to cell-state transitions in fibroblast and Notch systems.

ranked.headline: Curated knowledge bases link harmonized data to open web query interfaces
ranked.summary: Recent January and February 2026 releases extend curated, queryable resources to microbial metabolomics, IBD and lipid-protein interactomics.

ranked.headline: Mobile elements and recombination drive fungal and mitochondrial genome evolution
ranked.summary: Haplotype-resolved and organelle-level assemblies now resolve transposon, repeat and recombination dynamics across pathogens and heterotrophic plants.

ranked.headline: Computational models link microbial metabolism to tumor genes and drug transformations
ranked.summary: Metabolic modeling and time-resolved metabolomics now connect microbial taxa and their chemistry to host gene expression and drug transformation.

ranked.headline: Benchmarking and improved search tools advance mass spectrometry proteomics workflows
ranked.summary: Recent preprint and publications address quantitative benchmarking, spectral library search, and instrument performance monitoring in LC-MS proteomics.
